note: NAB under APRA's APS 330, which has no KM1 template. Level 2 basis - the table is headed 'Capital ratios (Level 2)'. Ratios from the capital ratios table and total RWA from the capital adequacy table, which sit on different pages; that is what the extractor's missing-core-row errors are about. This vintage predates APRA's leverage ratio and LCR disclosure requirements, which took effect on 1 July 2015, so neither is recorded, and these reports carry no detailed capital disclosure of amounts. The 2013 full-year report, 'as at 30 September 2013'.
